office_does: The sheriff is the county's chief law enforcement officer and runs the jail and civil process. Nonpartisan in San Juan County, four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: former Sheriff Ron Krebs (2015-2022) is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: San Juan County Sheriff from 2015 to 2022 and a 19-year veteran of the office; the only candidate.
highlights: Sheriff 2015-2022; 19 years with the Sheriff's Office [S1][S3]
Cites state accreditation, an expanded marine unit and modernized emergency communications [S1][S3]
Says the office faces recruitment, retention and morale problems [S3]
